u8cfef6a977: V127b added the triple synchronization function. For TWS products that need to synchronize the triple, the pairing function must be enabled first; triple synchronization can only be performed after pairing is complete.
ue2691d8e78: When TWS pairing is complete and "Triple sync enable" (三元组同步使能) is set to 1, the triple synchronization process starts. During the first synchronization, if one of the earbuds has no triple, "Sync complete" (同步完成) is displayed after the synchronization process; on subsequent power-ups, "Synced" (已同步) is displayed.
ua03c7454c3: The "Triple forced sync enable" (三元组强制同步使能) function is intended for cases where both earbuds have a triple but the data differs. If this function is set to 1, the triple data of the earbud that has it stored in flash is synchronized to the other earbud, and the other earbud's previous data is overwritten. Use this function with caution.
uaf065e1004: The TWS devices contain triple information; when the TWS devices are connected over UART and this test function is enabled, "No triple" is displayed
u631da4deff: Triple information has already been programmed into the flash of each of the two TWS earbuds
ud46c32e3d1: One of the TWS earbuds has no triple information and the other has triple information in its flash; after the first programming is complete, "Sync complete" is displayed
ucb9b794d5a: The triple has already been synchronized between the two TWS earbuds; apart from the first synchronization, every subsequent synchronization shows "Synced"
ucb6d567bd7: When the triple information in the two TWS earbuds differs and forced sync is not enabled, "Data mismatch" is displayed
u8a8cb1f1e2: When the triple information could not be synchronized because of a memory read/write operation, "Sync failed" (同步失败) is displayed

u9da45edaf6: What is multi-algorithm authorization?⟦1/⟧ Multi-algorithm authorization refers to the case where one SDK uses library functions from multiple algorithm providers, ⟦2/⟧ and all of these algorithm providers need to control the programming count of the chips (that is, these algorithm providers charge fees based on the number of devices produced).
ub47e252bc6: In the simplest multi-algorithm authorization scenario, there are generally the following three roles:
u0d63a223d0: Algorithm provider: an algorithm company that provides algorithm libraries
u6a7b453327: Solution developer: the manufacturer, i.e., the developer, who integrates the algorithms from the various providers and finally generates the programming file (FW file)
ud64aaaf7c1: Programming vendor: the programming house, i.e., the factory commissioned to carry out the actual production

ub09a0478a0: Solution owner: the brand owner, who sets the rules for the solution
ud83dc17c2d: Solution algorithm providers: algorithm company A, algorithm company B
u6b2f74cfd3: Actual solution developer: the solution provider

u02ac59bf87: Determine the size of the authorization data
u4341e4b980: The authorization data is the data that the algorithm company writes into the chip for authorization. Its size must be fixed and less than 256 bytes, and it cannot be changed once confirmed.
uda4614d841: The programming-time authorization executable, i.e., the ⟦1⟧.authrun⟦/1⟧ file, is a file that can run on the chip.
ucb7be14bac: During programming, the programmer executes all ⟦1⟧.authrun⟦/1⟧ files and writes the authorization information into the chip.
u0786f77746: The algorithm company needs to add its authorization algorithm to the programming-time authorization executable ⟦1⟧project template (click here to download)⟦/1⟧ (⟦2⟧Generate_Authorization⟦/2⟧) provided by Jieli, and build it to generate the programming-time authorization executable (⟦3⟧.authrun⟦/3⟧ file).
